Faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
Faq.subtitle: What you might be wondering
Faq.a1: Sessions are held over a secure video connection at a pre-arranged appointment time.
Faq.a2: After your appointment request, payment and coordination are handled via WhatsApp.
Faq.a3: Yes. All sessions are kept confidential in line with professional ethics and data-protection law.
Faq.a4: No. The service is psychological counseling and guidance; it does not include medical diagnosis, treatment, or medication advice. Referrals to relevant specialists are made when necessary.
Faq.q5: What should I do in an emergency?
Faq.a5: In emergencies please call 112. This platform is not suitable for crisis/emergency intervention.

Assessment.title: AI Pre-assessment
Assessment.subtitle: A few-minute, confidential pre-assessment
Assessment.intro: This short pre-assessment helps you understand how you've been feeling over the last 2 weeks. It uses standard screening scales (GAD-7 and PHQ-9).
Assessment.consentDisclaimer: This is an AI-assisted PRE-ASSESSMENT; it is NOT a medical diagnosis, treatment, or medication advice. The results do not replace a professional evaluation. Your data is processed confidentially and encrypted in line with data-protection law. In an emergency/crisis, please call 112.
Assessment.consentCheckbox: I have read and understood the above and want to continue.
Assessment.instructions: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by the following?
Assessment.concernPlaceholder: What's been weighing on you most lately? Feel free to share a few sentences...
Assessment.routingLow: There's no notable distress right now. You can keep checking in with yourself and book an intro call whenever you like.
Assessment.routingModerate: You may be experiencing a moderate level of distress. Talking with a counselor could help; you can start with a free intro call.
Assessment.routingHigh: You may be experiencing a notable level of distress. We recommend seeking professional support; a free intro call can be a good start.
Assessment.routingCrisis: This result may indicate an emergency. Please call 112 or go to the nearest emergency department.
Assessment.disclaimer: This result is not a diagnosis; it is only a pre-assessment.
